data.one_liner: Set Android wallpaper from a URL, file, bytes or asset.
data.what_it_does: Downloads an image (optionally with progress) and uses Android WallpaperManager to apply it as home, lock, both, or system wallpaper. Provides APIs to query recommended size and open the system chooser.
use_when: You need to change the device's wallpaper on Android
You want to download images with progress and apply them as wallpapers
avoid_when: You target iOS or other platforms
strengths: Handles download, caching and progress streams
Supports multiple targets (home, lock, both, system)
weaknesses: Relies on native WallpaperManager which may behave differently across manufacturers
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec and run flutter pub get; Android permissions (INTERNET, SET_WALLPAPER) are declared automatically.
